adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb` and `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`, and each contains only a single example asserting the controller subclasses `Admin::AdminController`. There are no specs for the newly introduced behaviors/endpoints (e.g., `create/update/destroy` in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` or `show/update` in `Admin::EmbeddingController`), nor for edge cases the new code could hit (e.g., missing record in `update/destroy`, invalid host params, uncategorized fallback, serializer payload shape/embedded IDs). This lack of meaningful test coverage is directly verifiable in the diff.
